description: Analyze apartment debt. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed). asOfDate defaults to today in the building's time zone (timezone in building settings) and splits overdue from dueSoon. The response echoes timezone and dueDay. Reminders target overdue apartments unless includeDueSoon is true. The overdue total matches generate_financial_report outstanding and the dashboard pending collections.
name: analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders
title: Debt reminders
